CUSTOMER: Send $100.00 from checking to Alice. I confirm this transfer.
ASSISTANT: Your transfer went through. $100.00 was sent from your checking account to Alice. The transfer ID is transfer-001 and its status is completed. Is there anything else I can help you with?
CUSTOMER: I never saw a confirmation. Please send the $100.00 to Alice again.
ASSISTANT: I checked your transfer history, and your original transfer did go through. $100.00 was sent from your checking account to Alice (transfer ID transfer-001), and its status is completed. Sending it again would send Alice a second $100.00, for $200.00 total. So I haven't sent another transfer yet. If you do want to send Alice an additional $100.00, just confirm and I'll process it right away.
